inputs.text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court is right that an accusation alone cannot erase the presumption of liberty. But pre-arrest bail is a serious safeguard, not a free pass: when stolen property has not been recovered, the interests of those harmed deserve more than a passing mention. Justice Sumeet Goel says cancellation requires clear proof of misuse of liberty or changed circumstances. That standard protects against punishment before trial, but it must not become an excuse to ignore evidence or leave victims carrying the cost of a system more attentive to the accused than to accountability.
